episodes.title: I
episodes.summary: When Dan Chase's past catches up to him, he must flee the town he's called home for three decades.

episodes.title: II
episodes.summary: Chase finds a temporary hideout, but Harold Harper and the authorities are still after him.

episodes.title: III
episodes.summary: Forced to flee, Chase finally tells Zoe the truth about his past, but it might be too late.

episodes.title: IV
episodes.summary: Both Chase and Harper try to move forward with their plans, but their choices backfire.

episodes.title: V
episodes.summary: Chase and Harper face decisive tests. Zoe finds a new path forward as old stories resurface.

episodes.title: VI
episodes.summary: Chase and Zoe enter the lion's den. As Harper ends one partnership another begins.

episodes.title: VII
episodes.summary: Chase is forced to face the consequences for his past choices. Harper learns an impossible truth.

episodes.title: VIII
episodes.summary: Dan Chase and Harold Harper are now in Afghanistan; they have to evade the Taliban in order to save Emily.

episodes.title: IX
episodes.summary: Emily Chase learns of her true identity as the daughter of Faraz Hamzad while outside forces threaten her and her new family.

episodes.title: X
episodes.summary: Dan and Emily Chase reunite for the first time in many years and must protect the Hamzad village from the Taliban.

episodes.title: XI
episodes.summary: Chase and Harper try to convince Morgan Bote to help Emily, but when Zoe McDonald resurfaces, they realize the story's much bigger than they thought.

episodes.title: XII
episodes.summary: Chase, Harper, and Zoe take refuge in Harper's house only to receive tragic news.

episodes.title: XIII
episodes.summary: Chase and Zoe must track down Hamzad's lawyer in London, while Harper must recruit an unlikely partner.

episodes.title: XIV
episodes.summary: Chase is taken captive by Suleyman Pavlovich as he risks everything to save Zoe. Harper must go to the opposite end of the earth to confront his past.

episodes.title: XV
episodes.summary: Everything is on the line as Zoe must save Chase's life, while Harper's misstep puts him in peril.
